key_points: Q3 investment banking fee guidance of >10% YoY decline to ~$1B triggered an 8% stock drop last week, the dominant near-term catalyst.
The selloff may be overdone as the stock now trades below estimated fair value after its prior run, providing valuation support.
BofA's own AI efficiency narrative and raised S&P 500 target (7,400) offer offsetting medium-term positives.
Smaller headlines (LSCC stake, NGVC coverage, Uber/UPS PT changes) are low-signal and immaterial to BAC's own thesis.
New debt issuances and preferred dividend declarations reflect ongoing funding activity but don't materially change the capital structure outlook.
